questions: Is the child having any difficulty breathing (e.g., fast breathing, wheezing, or chest indrawing)?
Does the child have any ear pain or ear discharge (fluid/pus) from the ear?
How long has she had the fever and cough (and is the sore throat from the beginning or later)?
How high has the fever been at its highest (and how was it measured)?
Has she had any difficulty swallowing, drooling, or a change in voice/stridor (noisy breathing on inhalation)?
Has the child had any shortness of breath or wheezing when breathing, and if so does it worsen at night or with activity?
Has the child had any vomiting, rash, or eye redness/conjunctivitis?
Has she had any rapid breathing or chest indrawing when you look at her at rest (and about how many breaths per minute)?
Has she had any difficulty swallowing, and can she drink and keep fluids down?
Has the child had any measured temperature of **≥ 38.0°C (100.4°F)**, and if so what was the highest reading and how was it measured (oral/ear/forehead)?
